verdict.line: You lose if he stacks three hits on you before level 6 and chains into Realm of Death; you win once Hollow Radiance and Jak'Sho come online and he can't burst through the health pool.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser wins the lane phase and the solo-kill numbers because every auto and spell he lands builds toward his passive, Darkness Rise, which then snowballs the exact trade you're already losing. Sion has no counter-engage until Q (Cryptic Gaze) is up, so the matchup is about denying him free stacks, not winning trades outright. The 51% head-to-head over 153 games confirms this evens out once Sion's health-stacking and tank items come online.

theirWindow.when: he's already landed two hits on you
theirWindow.what: Back off immediately. A third hit lands his passive aura and move speed burst, and the trade you're in gets worse every second you stay in range.

yourWindow.when: his W (Indestructible) shield just popped to heal
yourWindow.what: That shield is gone and takes time to rebuild. Flash E (Enrage) on, land Q (Cryptic Gaze) for the stun, and commit the trade now rather than later.

start.why: The 111-game sample (46.8% win rate, 54.7% pick) absorbs his early autos while you're still farming for E (Enrage) stacks — you need the chip sustain more than you need the early trade.

boots.why: 55.9% win rate over 68 games, well ahead of Mercury's Treads. Morde has no slow, only a pull — the extra move speed lets you create the distance OP.GG's own tip calls for to deny Darkness Rise.

core.why: First item in the 71.4%-win, 14-game top path — the magic resist directly answers his all-magic kit.
Second item in that same path, adds the health and damage reduction that makes your post-6 trades survivable.
Closes out the 71.4%-win core — stacking resistances lets Enrage's health-for-damage trade keep paying off into late game.

situational.when: he's leaning on autos to stack Darkness Rise and heal off (W) Indestructible
you need more wave-clear and dueling damage rather than pure resistances
the game goes long and you want a bigger health pool for teamfight presence

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the auto-attack trades you're forced into anyway and scales your max health, which stacks directly with what E (Enrage) is already converting into damage.

summoners.why: 87% of Sion players take this into Mordekaiser (48.1% win rate) — Teleport resets you after losing trades and skips the minion damage you'd otherwise eat while scaling, and Flash keeps you out of Death's Grasp range (700) when he goes for the pull.

playing.title: Don't farm with E on
playing.detail: Enrage costs health per auto with no cooldown gate, so only toggle it when you're committing to a trade — leaving it on while last-hitting just feeds Morde free damage racking toward his passive.

playing.title: Break line of sight after two hits
playing.detail: Darkness Rise needs three landed hits to trigger. Disengaging after the second denies the damage aura and move speed burst that turns a bad trade into a lost one.

playing.title: Punish his shield-less window
playing.detail: Watch for him consuming Indestructible's stored shield to heal — that's the moment he's softest. Stun with Q (Cryptic Gaze) and all-in immediately after.

playing.title: Play safe from level 6 to 11
playing.detail: Realm of Death isolates and steals your stats on a kill. Don't overextend for farm or skirmishes in this window; the solo-kill numbers favor him here specifically.

playing.title: Use W to soak, not just to burst
playing.detail: Death's Caress's shield can absorb an Obliterate or an auto string before you detonate it — holding it a beat longer often wins more health than popping it instantly.

playing.title: Save R for skirmishes, not duels
playing.detail: Cannibalism's 90-second cooldown and nearby-ally healing make it far more valuable in 2v2s and teamfights than in a 1v1 you're already behind in.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: Create some distance to deactivate his (P). Avoid his (E) while focusing on farming and contesting lane.
